cohort: The study involves a literature review on otherwise healthy newborns with birth-related long bone fractures and a case report of a female neonate diagnosed with a femoral shaft fracture.
finding: Birth-related long bone fractures can occur in otherwise healthy newborns, generally heal without surgical intervention, and require timely diagnosis and proper management to avoid medico-legal liability.
mod_finding: The literature review investigated the incidence of birth-related long bone fractures in relation to the mode of delivery.
